title: Morflax Studio - 3D Mockups & Motion in Your Browser
key_takeaways: Morflax Studio runs entirely in the browser, so 3D mockup and motion work needs no Blender or Cinema 4D install.
SVG-to-3D conversion turns an existing logo or vector mark directly into a 3D object for brand renders.
Environment control through HDRIs, stylized skies, and custom backgrounds is the main lever for scene mood.
Post-processing effects and cinematic filters are applied inside the same tool, so no separate finishing pass is needed.
A template library plus category generators (abstract, shapes, devices, apparel, branding, icons) gives a fast start instead of an empty scene.
Custom 3D model upload lets real product geometry replace generic props.
The Scene Builder composes multiple generated elements into one presentation image.
Freemium model: some templates are free, and other features are marked Pro only.

title: Watermelon UI — production-ready UI systems and components
key_takeaways: Watermelon UI ships production-ready UI systems and components aimed at startups and developers, not design mockups.
The account claims a user base above 100k.
It is a product account owned by the parent handle @watermelonshHQ.
The account is new (joined March 2026) with a small follower count but a high post rate, so it posts component drops frequently.
Useful as a source for component-level UI patterns rather than long-form design writing.

title: Blank Embrace — visually encapsulated feelings
key_takeaways: Blank Embrace is a digital mixed media artist account, useful as visual reference rather than written design theory.
The stated intent is emotional: images that encapsulate feelings, so the work is a source for mood and art direction.
Verified account with roughly 47k followers and a very high post volume (64k+ posts), so the feed is a dense image archive.
Active since 2019, which gives a long back catalogue to mine for visual references.

title: Mac Baconai — New Era Aesthetic
key_takeaways: Mac Baconai posts under a "New Era Aesthetic" banner, which frames the account around AI-native visual style.
The account is Creative Ambassador for Perplexity AI, so expect tool-linked creative work and announcements.
Large reach (about 222k followers) makes this a trend-setting source for AI image and video aesthetics.
Active since January 2023 with 18k+ posts, so the feed tracks the whole recent AI creative-tool cycle.

title: mendezmendez — documenting the human experience, one daily artwork at a time
key_takeaways: The account runs on a daily-artwork discipline, which is the concrete practice model worth copying: one finished piece per day.
Subject matter is the human experience, so the work is narrative and observational rather than abstract.
Verified, about 76k followers, and 54k+ posts since 2017 — a long-running proof that daily output compounds reach.
Best used as a reference for illustration style and for the daily-practice workflow itself.

title: soli — independent art curator
key_takeaways: soli is an independent art curator account, so the value is the selection, not original work.
Very large reach (about 1.23M followers) from a low post rate relative to size — curation, not volume, drives the account.
Running since 2015 with roughly 18k posts, it is a deep, already-filtered archive for moodboards and taste building.
Follows only 659 accounts, which signals a tight curated input set worth mining for further sources.
